summary: Defines the SiteDocument entity representing documents linked to specific sites. Used as a data contract or DTO.
purpose: To represent and store the relationship of documents with specific sites.

summary: ASP.NET page for staff administrators, presenting welcome information and last login details. Includes UI validation and error handling.
purpose: To serve as the welcome landing page for staff administrators, showing relevant notices, last login time, and error/warning messages.

fields.name: ltlLastLogin
fields.description: Literal control for displaying last login time.

workflows.name: Page Load
steps: Setup the HSPnet page with current session and master/footer references.
Register required JavaScript files for staff admin UI.
Display personalized greeting and last login information.
Make last login panel visible if data is present.

conditions: Show last login panel only if last login data is available.
If not postback, populate site and discipline dropdowns and set default date range.
system_behavior: Auto-generates UI fields and handles initialization logic for the landing page.
dependencies: Uses JavaScript files WelcomeStaffAdmin.js and Date.js.

summary: Represents service codes, including categorization and localization of code descriptions. Provides static methods to retrieve lists of service codes filtered by course, timetable, or all.
purpose: To define and retrieve service codes used in the system, supporting categorization, sorting, and language localization.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Category identifier for grouping service codes.

workflows.name: Retrieve Service Code List
steps: Open DB connection and set stored procedure, e.g. ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.
Execute procedure with appropriate parameters.
For each result row: create ServiceCode, assign fields, apply localization if needed, add to list.
Return list.

business_rules: If alternate language mode is enabled (sess.UseAltLanguageFields), use NameAlt/NotesAlt for display values.
conditions: Language context determines which descriptive fields to use.
system_behavior: Provides static access to filtered lists of ServiceCode objects via the data layer.
dependencies: SQL stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID.

summary: Represents the history of profile changes for a site, including who made the change, when, and what was changed.
purpose: To store and retrieve detailed audit logs of site profile changes, including actions taken, user details, and agency information.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of UI where the action occurred.

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of the user who performed the action.

fields.name: ByOriginalUserID
fields.description: Original user if acting as another user.

fields.name: AgencyUserDetailsFormatted
fields.description: Full formatted user and agency details.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Retrieval
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session.
Open DB connection, configure stored procedure, assign parameters.
Iterate result set and map to SiteProfileHistory objects.
Format fields according to alternate language and localization settings.
Return list.

business_rules: If session is alternate language, use alt fields for UI strings.
If the acting user is a sysadmin or acting as someone else, display special support text.
calculations: Formats ActionDate and user display fields for UI.
conditions: UserSession object must be present for selection.
system_behavior: Captures full audit and context for every site profile change, including phone number masking.
dependencies: Uses NameFormatter, DateFormatter, Phone type for formatting.
exceptions: Selection cancels if UserSession is missing.

summary: Represents documents shown in email popups and supports their management, including add, search, and delete operations.
purpose: To allow searching and deleting of documents attached to email popups, managing file paths and deletion state.

workflows.name: Email Popup Document Search
steps: Split dataInfo string by | separator.
For each entry, split by > to get (fileName, filePath) pair.
Create EmailPopupDocument for each, assigning ID, FileName, FilePath.
Add to list.

workflows.name: Email Popup Document Delete
steps: Split dataInfo string by | separator.
For the document with matching ID, get file path, attempt to delete file from system.
Attempt to delete containing folder.
Rebuild dataInfo string excluding deleted entry.

conditions: File or directory deletes are wrapped in try/catch; failures are silently ignored.
system_behavior: Handles file system operations for document management in email popups.
exceptions: File/Directory deletion exceptions are caught and suppressed.
